title: Northrop B-35 flying wing in flight, air-to-air view (Fig. 6)
description: Air-to-air photograph of the Northrop B-35 flying wing bomber seen edge-on with its four propeller engines, flying over water, with part of the camera aircraft's nose visible at upper right. Text above notes it is powered by four reciprocating engines with a 172-foot wing span and a length of only 53 feet. Captioned "Fig. 6".
